clusters.headline: President Trump Signals Potential De-escalation In Iran Relations
aiSummaryBullets: President Trump stated that ordering further military strikes against Iran is unlikely as the nation seeks to negotiate a deal.
The Iranian Foreign Minister reports that diplomatic discussions with the United States have not yet seen significant progress.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
